source.author: verg
source.text: Interea magno misceri murmure pontum, emissamque hiemem sensit Neptunus, et imis stagna refusa vadis, graviter commotus; et alto prospiciens, summa placidum caput extulit unda.
source.text_original: Interea magno misceri murmure pontum, / emissamque hiemem sensit Neptunus, et imis / stagna refusa vadis, graviter commotus; et alto / prospiciens, summa placidum caput extulit unda.
source.text_english: Meanwhile Neptune perceived that the sea was being stirred with a great roar, and that the winter storm had been let loose and the waters, driven back, were flowing over the deepest shallows; deeply agitated, and looking out over the deep, he raised his calm head above the topmost wave.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: Graia novam ferro molem commenta iuventus pergit et ingenti gaudens domat aequora velo, nec mihi libertas imis freta tollere harenis, qualis eram nondum vinclis et carcere clausus.
reuse.text_original: Graia novam ferro molem commenta iuventus / pergit et ingenti gaudens domat aequora velo, / nec mihi libertas imis freta tollere harenis, / qualis eram nondum vinclis et carcere clausus.
reuse.text_english: The Greek youth goes on devising a new mass of iron and, rejoicing, subdues the seas with a great sail, nor is it freedom for me to lift the deep waters from the lowest sands, such as I was before, not yet shut in by chains and prison.
